scene: The glowing turquoise console unlocks three transit bay doors side by side.
picture: A flat side view inside the grand planetarium exit concourse along a level marble floor. In the left-centre, the girl in her teal hoodie sits in her purple wheelchair beside the console. On the far left waits a steam train. In the centre, an airship floats. On the far right sits a delivery truck.
shown: a brass-trimmed steam train puffing sweet peppermint smoke at the far left bay
a moored striped airship rocking gently at the middle bay gate, centre
a yellow robotic delivery truck with its cargo ramp lowered, far right
